description: Let \(f:A\to N\) be partial elementary between nonempty structures, with strongly minimal source structure \(M\). If \(a\notin\operatorname{acl}_M(A)\) and \(b\notin\operatorname{acl}_N(f[A])\), there is a partial elementary extension with domain \(A\cup\{a\}\), range \(f[A]\cup\{b\}\), and value \(b\) at \(a\).
